description: This line plot illustrates how the PPL (Perplexity) metric changes with varying context window sizes (labeled on the x-axis as 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, and 64K) for three different values of the parameter y—0.25, 0.5, and 0.75—as indicated by the legend. The y-axis represents PPL on a linear scale, ranging from 7.7 to 8.2. The x-axis is also linear and labeled in units of K (thousands), with tick marks at regular intervals of 2K. The blue line, corresponding to y=0.25, starts at a PPL of approximately 8.2 at 2K, decreases to about 7.82 at 4K, then slightly increases to around 7.84 at 8K before declining again to about 7.78 at 64K. The orange line for y=0.5 begins at approximately 8.2 at 2K, drops to about 7.78 at 8K, and then remains relatively flat, hovering near 7.77 from 16K to 64K. The green line for y=0.75 starts at 8.2 at 2K, falls to about 7.85 at 4K, then continues to decline to approximately 7.77 at 8K, and stabilizes near 7.77 from 16K to 64K. All three lines show a general downward trend in PPL as the context window increases, with the y=0.25 curve exhibiting the most significant initial drop.
